_comment: Golden set for the Stage 2 classifier. Each case is a unified diff plus the label a careful human reviewer would give it. LOW means 'cannot alter behaviour meaningfully' per src/model/prompt.ts — not merely 'small'. Accuracy on the HIGH cases is the safety number: a HIGH case classified low is a false-preserve candidate and is treated as a failure, whereas a LOW case classified high only costs a re-review.
